functional_correctness.description: Evaluates whether the code correctly implements the requirements and produces the expected results.

bug_sensitivity.description: Assesses the code's ability to handle edge cases and detect bugs, ensuring it doesn't introduce subtle errors.

engineering_quality.description: Measures the overall quality of the code, including adherence to best practices and coding standards.

efficiency.description: Evaluates the time and space complexity of the solution, ensuring it meets performance requirements.

robustness.description: Assesses the code's reliability when faced with unexpected inputs or conditions.

api_library_usage.description: Evaluates the appropriate use of libraries and APIs, ensuring they enhance the code without unnecessary complications.

readability.description: Measures how easily the code can be read and understood by others, considering naming conventions, comments, and structure.

maintainability.description: Assesses how easily the code can be modified or extended in the future.

error_handling.description: Evaluates how well the code anticipates and handles potential errors, including security vulnerabilities.
